display_information.name: QRdx
display_information.description: Make QR codes in Slack, and get QRdx scan and form alerts in a channel.
display_information.long_description: Type /qr with a link or any text and QRdx posts a QR code image in the channel, with buttons to download it as PNG or SVG or open it in the QRdx editor. You can also mention the bot, send it a direct message, or pick Make a QR code from a message's menu. People who link their QRdx account with /qr link can make tracked (dynamic) codes with /qr track. The same app posts the QRdx alerts you choose (scan milestones, form responses, code changes) to a channel.

slash_commands.description: Make a QR code from a link or any text
slash_commands.usage_hint: [link or text] | track [link] | link | unlink | help

shortcuts.name: Make a QR code
shortcuts.description: A QR code of the message's first link, or of its text
